name: Zabbix Monitoring Coverage
description: Monitoring-coverage and collector-health review for a customer's Zabbix: disabled and unreachable hosts, hosts with no templates or triggers, templates linked to nothing, site proxies that stopped reporting, proxy group HA state, maintenance windows that never end, and disabled web scenarios. Covers host status, interface availability and proxy state fields across Zabbix 6.x and 7.x. Read-only.
